mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or UNRATE rise > 0.5% does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or RSAFS decline does not correlate with subsequent consumer demand weakness.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or INDPRO increase > 1% does not correlate with subsequent supply-side strength.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or the joint movement of UNRATE and PAYEMS does not correlate with subsequent labor market weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over two consecutive months signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or HOUST increase does not correlate with subsequent housing demand strength.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals a supply-side contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially during a late-cycle expansion regime.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or GDPC1 decrease > 1% QoQ does not correlate with subsequent supply-side contraction during late-cycle expansion.
